60878090: The Town and Port of Dieppe is an 1842 landscape painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey. it depicts the town and port of Dieppe in Normandy in the Romantic style at its height during the period.
The Town and Port of Dieppe
106465622: Boats on the Shore at Calais is an 1851 landscape painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey. It shows a view of the coastline at Calais on the English Channel.
Boats on the Shore at Calais
106672229: The Battle of Texel is an 1839 historical seascape painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey.
112262592: The Port of Dunkirk is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey, from 1831. It depicts a view of the port town of Dunkirk on the North Sea of France close to the border with Belgium.
114052076: Hurricane Before Saint Malo is an 1860 oil painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey. It depicts a violent storm approaching the port town of Saint-Malo in Brittany as sailors and townsfolk attempt to pull a vessel to safety ashore.
137217362: The Return of Napoleon is an 1842 history painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey. It depicts the night transfer of the body of Napoleon to the French Navy frigate French frigate Belle Poule.
